title: 365ART bringing everything art to Lewisburg - NewsBreak
text:
By Ashley Davidson No media credit provided. ,
1 days ago
LEWISBURG, WV (WVNS) — Break out your brushes, dust off your looms, and get ready to learn!
365ART, an art supply store, gallery, and studio all in one, has opened in Lewisburg.
With watercolors, woodworking, refurbished clothes, and handwoven rugs and scarves on display, 365ART hopes to showcase local art, while also encouraging others to find their passion.
Owner Jill Spencer and resident artist Jeanne Brenneman said encouraging people to explore art is so important.
“Then we also, we found this space and noticed there was room for studios as well. And so we have some marvelous artists that are here with us, they’re gonna be teaching classes as well as having their work in the store,” said Spencer.
“Oh, everybody has to have a creative outlet in their life because it just brings you a lot of joy. And pick something that you’re really passionate about. And it’s great therapy,” said Brenneman.
Brenneman said she is very excited about teaching her watercolor classes in hopes on getting people hooked on the medium she has loved since the 1970s.
Spencer said there will be a variety of other classes available, most for free.
Spencer encouraged everyone to come in and check out the gallery and maybe sign up for a class or two.
